Date: Wed, 8 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC timeline & success criteria — Acme Industries

Hi Sophie / Carlos,

Thanks again for the call today — great conversation and lots of alignment on the evaluation goals. As promised, summary and a proposed POC plan below so we can lock timelines and owners. I've attached a one-page POC plan and a RACI.

Quick recap of what you said was most important:
- End-to-end latency under 500ms for typical queries (50k token/month baseline)
- Ability to serve private customer data with VPC + KMS controls
- Observable cost per 1k tokens and per-route breakdown for the evaluation period
- No data persistence outside your environment for PII flows

Proposed POC: 3-week trial focused on a representative subset of workflows
1) Kickoff (week 1): technical onboarding, SSO + network checks, baseline traffic profile
2) Evaluation (weeks 1-2): run 3 canonical scenarios, collect latency/cost/quality metrics
3) Final readout (week 3): results, regression checks, next-step decision

Success criteria (examples — please confirm):
- Latency: median end-to-end < 500ms for scenario A, P95 < 1s
- Accuracy/quality: model outputs match domain acceptance on > 85% of test prompts (we'll define exact eval set)
- Ops: SSO + VPC connectivity validated, no PII persisted in logs; role-based access working
- Cost telemetry: per-route cost visible in console, and projected monthly unit cost within your target range

Owners / roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (project lead), Vivek (solution architecture / SSO), Monica (onboarding & weekly check-ins)
- Acme: Sophie (product owner), Carlos (IT / infra), Acme IT (network)

Draft timeline (proposed)
- Wed Jul 8: Send plan (this email) + attachments
- Week of Jul 20: Kickoff (1 hour) + network/SSO checks
- Week of Jul 20-31: Run scenarios, daily ingest as needed; weekly check-in (30 min)
- Fri Aug 7: Final readout and next-step decision

Next steps
- Sophie / Carlos: confirm success criteria and available kickoff windows during week of Jul 20
- Vivek: follow up on SSO requirements and network allowlist
- Monica: prepare onboarding materials and invite for weekly check-ins

Attachments:
- Acme_POC_Plan_2026-07-08.pdf (POC scope, scenarios, data requirements)
- Redwood_POC_Roles_RACI.xlsx

Happy to adjust — if this looks good I'll send calendar invites for the kickoff once we confirm a slot.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — this is really helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) SSO / auth: we plan to require SAML SSO with SCIM provisioning for this POC. Can Vivek confirm Redwood supports SAML + SCIM for the private deployment? Also, do you support SP-initiated vs. IdP-initiated flows?

2) Data handling: you mentioned no PII persisted in logs. Can you confirm what redact/retention settings we'll have during the POC and whether we can export logs for our audit team?

3) Importing sample data: for the evaluation we'll provide a ~10k row CSV of anonymized customer prompts. Is there a simple uploader or should we use the API?

On timing — Jul 20 week should work for the kickoff, but we prefer Tue/Wed morning PT. Carlos, can you confirm your availability for Tue Jul 21 or Wed Jul 22 mornings?

I'll loop in our infra team (cc'ed).

Sophie Liang
Director, Product Management
